5.5 Case Studies: IT Industry

Product-Based: Infosys BPM

Division of Infosys providing business process management and outsourcing

Services: Finance & accounting, procurement, customer service, HR outsourcing

Revenue: ~$2.5B (FY2023); serves 170+ clients globally

Innovation: AI-powered automation using Infosys Cobalt (cloud), Nia (AI platform)

Services-Based: TCS (Tata Consultancy Services)

Largest Indian IT company; market cap ~$150B+

Operations: 150+ countries, 600,000+ employees

Key verticals: BFSI, Retail, Manufacturing, Life Sciences, Energy

Notable projects: UK NHS systems, Zurich Insurance transformation, NFL digital platforms

TCS BaNCS: Core banking product used by 400+ financial institutions globally — product + services hybrid

5.6 Recent Technology Advancements in IT

5.7 Current Affairs — IT Industry

India's Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI): India Stack recognized globally — UPI, Aadhaar, DigiLocker as model for developing nations

AI Regulation: EU AI Act (2024) — world's first comprehensive AI law; India working on Digital India Act

Data Protection: DPDP Act 2023 (Digital Personal Data Protection Act) — India's comprehensive data privacy law

IT Talent War: Global competition for AI/ML, cloud, and cybersecurity talent; significant salary premiums

GCC Boom: Global Capability Centres in India growing rapidly — 1,600+ GCCs employing 1.9M workers

Layoffs and Restructuring: Major tech layoffs in 2022–2024 (Microsoft, Google, Meta) due to post-pandemic correction

5.8 Diversity in the Workforce

Workforce diversity refers to the variety of differences between people in an organization — including but not limited to gender, race, age, religion, disability, educational background, and national origin.

Types of Diversity in IT Workforce

Gender Diversity: Increasing women's representation in technical and leadership roles

Racial and Ethnic Diversity: Particularly important in US-based tech companies

Neurodiversity: Including individuals with autism, ADHD, dyslexia in the workforce

Age Diversity: Bridging gaps between Gen Z, Millennials

4. Marketing Plan

Market segmentation: Define target customer segments precisely

Total Addressable Market (TAM), Serviceable Addressable Market (SAM), Serviceable Obtainable Market (SOM)

Customer personas: Detailed profiles of ideal customers

Competitive analysis: Strengths/weaknesses vs. key competitors

Go-to-market strategy: Channels and tactics for customer acquisition

Digital marketing: SEO, content marketing, paid ads, social media strategy

Sales strategy: Inside sales, field sales, channel partners, self-service

Pricing strategy: Cost-based, value-based, competitive, penetration

Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) and Lifetime Value (LTV) projections

5. Operational Plan

Daily and monthly operations: What activities keep the business running?

Technology infrastructure: Cloud services, development tools, security

Supply chain / vendor management (if applicable)

Key processes: Development lifecycle, QA, deployment, customer support

Key metrics tracked: NPS, uptime, ticket resolution time, deployment frequency

Compliance: Data protection (GDPR, IT Act), security certifications (ISO 27001)

6. Management and Organization

Organizational structure: Flat, hierarchical, or matrix

Founders and key team members — bios with relevant experience

Board of Directors / Advisors: Names, backgrounds, contribution

Hiring plan: Roles to be filled, timeline, compensation structure

ESOP (Employee Stock Option Pool): Typically 10–15% reserved for employee options

7. Personal Financial Statement

Personal assets and liabilities of founders

Required when seeking bank loans or SBA-type government loans

Demonstrates founders' personal financial stability and 'skin in the game'

Required for collateral assessment by lenders

8. Startup Expenses and Capitalization

9. Financial Plan

Revenue Model: How will the company earn money? (Subscription, licensing, transaction fees, advertising)

Revenue Projections: Monthly/quarterly for 3–5 years with assumptions clearly stated

Profit & Loss Statement
